name: Node View Redirect
description: Implements a redirect from node view to a existing path for each content type
project_description: Node View Redirect redirects a node's canonical view page to a configured existing internal path, chosen per content type. On a KernelEvents::REQUEST event subscriber it inspects the entity.node.canonical route, and when the node's bundle is enabled and the current user lacks authoring/editing permissions on that bundle (unless the per-bundle 'no permission exception' is set, which forces the redirect for everyone), it resolves the configured path to an internal route and issues a RedirectResponse. Targets are set by an administrator on the settings form and validated as internal routes.
